summary: Service operations for DjangoLux's Operations panel: list, restart, recreate and read logs.
highlights: DjangoLux 1.13.0b2's Operations panel can list services, restart or recreate allow-listed ones and read recent logs through new named operations.
The executor gains a 'recreate' operation under the same allow-list as 'restart'.
Includes 1.7.0b1: the maintenance page ships in this image; release-manifest.json replaces VERSION; stack hardening.
